questions.stem_text:
A car covers a distance of 30 miles in 1/2 hour. What is its speed in miles per hour and
in feet per second?

options.A: 30 mi per hr, 60 ft per sec
options.B: 90 mi per hr, 132 ft per sec
options.C: 75 mi per hr, 110 ft per sec
options.D: 60 mi per hr, 55 ft per sec
options.E: 45 mi per hr, 88 ft per sec

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - 30 mi per hr, 60 ft per sec

questions.stem_text:
An object of mass 100 g is at rest. A net force of 2000 dynes is applied for 10 sec. What
is the final velocity? How far will the object have moved in the 10-sec interval?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - 200 cm/sec and 10 m

questions.stem_text:
What is the ratio of intensities of Rayleigh scattering for the two hydrogen lines
\lambda_1 = 410 nm and \lambda_2 = 656 nm?
Why can't we see the Sun's corona except during total solar eclipses?

options.B: The corona is blocked by the Earth's atmosphere
options.C: The corona is hidden by the Sun's photosphere
options.D: The corona is made up mostly of charged particles which aren't luminous.
options.E: The Sun's corona is actually invisible to the human eye

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - We can't see magnetic fields
